notes:
Fixed
- Auto-update now verifies the app actually reopened, reports a blocked relaunch as a failure, and carries the helper's log into the app log.
- Windows: updating keeps your uninstaller (no more orphaned Apps entry or stacked installs).
- "Download manually..." now gives Windows users the setup installer, not the updater's zip.
- Rich descriptions no longer reload and re-probe the model on every clip; unparseable output now counts against a model.
- iPhone HEIC photos get thumbnails again, so they are described and enter visual search.
- A stalled AI stage no longer reads as a finished one: it says how many clips are held and why, and diagnostics bundles carry a new "AI stages" section.
- The first-run wizard opens at the size of its own text, scrolls, and no longer paints hints over the controls.
- New Project shows the whole folder path.
- Folder names keep their dots, so "Drehtag_20.08.26" stays intact.
- The Advanced toggle is remembered between launches.
- Choosing Cloud API sticks even before you paste the key.

Added
- A project remembers the preset it was created under and re-applies it when you switch back: folder structure, colour, Fairlight, auto-cut and the default AI toggles. Opt-in per project.
